notes: Version 1, pre-registered before any test metric was computed. The effort question's axis wording is cairn/5132's rubric verbatim ('deliberation per step (mechanical, up to subtle debugging, algorithms, proofs about state)'); 5132 names only the axis ends, so the five anchor descriptors are this bench's. Scope is a sibling question on how much must change. Both are option-independent (tenet 1328): neither names a recipe, model, tier or project. The predictor reads each question's expected score, sum of level value times probability.
preamble: Below is a software task exactly as it was filed for an AI coding agent to carry out. Answer each question from the text alone.

questions.name: effort
questions.instructions: Effort: deliberation per step (mechanical, up to subtle debugging, algorithms, proofs about state). How much careful thought does each step of this task need?

levels.description: Mechanical: every step is obvious once it is found
Mostly routine steps with occasional small judgment calls
Ordinary engineering judgment at most steps
Subtle debugging or non-obvious design at several steps
Algorithms or proofs about state: steps need sustained, careful reasoning

questions.name: scope
questions.instructions: Scope: how much must change or be produced to finish this task, from one small local edit up to many places across several parts of a system?

levels.description: Several places in one part of the system
Many places, or several parts of the system
A broad change across many parts of the system
